senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. f. Esther, wife of king Ahasverus.
units: Ex. R. s. 15 ובאה א׳ והאירה and Esther (bright star, v. אִסְתְּהַר) came and brought light.
Meg. 13ᵃ; a. fr.—מגילת א׳, or only א׳, the Book of Esther.
